title: Drawdown Recovery Speed Analysis
description: Comprehensive analysis of drawdown episodes, recovery speed, Ulcer index, Pain index, and monthly loss probability for all VolPred strategies vs SPY buy-and-hold.

references: Martin, P. (1987). 'An Exact Measure of Risk: The Ulcer Index'
Keating, C. & Shadwick, W.F. (2002). 'A Universal Performance Measure'
Bacon, C.R. (2008). 'Practical Portfolio Performance Measurement and Attribution'

practical_insight.question: For an investor who checks monthly, which strategy minimizes chance of seeing a loss?
practical_insight.answer: Piecewise Conservative has the lowest monthly loss probability at 7.7%, meaning an investor checking monthly would see a loss only 7.7% of the time.

key_findings: Fastest average recovery: Risk Parity (SPY+GLD) at 12.8 days
Lowest Ulcer Index: Piecewise Conservative at 0.00704
Best Pain-adjusted Sharpe: Piecewise Conservative at 343.4
Slowest average recovery: VIX+Leading (0050.TW) at 59.7 days
Best monthly check strategy: Piecewise Conservative (7.7% loss months)
SPY buy-and-hold comparison: Ulcer=0.03470, Sharpe=0.948, Monthly loss=30.8%
